Sword Atlas

Rapier

Espada ropera

Origin
Spain and Italy
Period
c. 1500 to 1700
Blade
100 cm
Weight
0.9 to 1.2 kg
Edge
Double, made for the thrust
Grip
One-handed

The rapier is a slender sword built to thrust. It developed in the 1500s as a civilian sidearm worn with everyday clothes, and its swept or cup-shaped hilt protected the hand.

Fencing masters such as Salvator Fabris published treatises around 1600 that moved sword fighting toward the point and the straight line.
